description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability and Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki and tapping it.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Blasting Station's last ability triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.
